sections.title: Changed items
notes:
The following items now have a "Use" option like evolutionary stones:
- Deep Sea Scale
- Deep Sea Tooth
- Dragon Scale
- Dubious Disc
- Electirizer
- King's Rock
- Magmarizer
- Metal Coat
- Protector
- Reaper Cloth
- Up-Grade

The following items have had adjustments to their costs:
- Poké Ball     ($200 >> $50)
- Great Ball    ($600 >> $150)
- Ultra Ball    ($1200 >> $300)

The following items now cost zero and are thus unsellable:
- All TMs
